title: Save Contact after adding an Address and a KYC document via '+ Add' actually creates the contact record
preconditions: Logged in as admin, branch NEYVELI CAO selected, New Contact form open, all mandatory Personal Details filled in.
steps: 1. Fill Address Details (Plot/Flat, Street, Area, City, Country, State, District, Pincode) and click '+ Add' - address appears in the address table. 2. Fill KYC Documents (Document Type=Address Proof, Document Name=Aadhar Card, valid-format Reference Number, Month, Year, uploaded file) and click '+ Add' - document appears in the KYC table. 3. Click 'Save Contact'. 4. Verify a success response/navigation occurs and the new contact is findable via search.
expected: The contact is created successfully once a valid address and KYC document are both present in their summary tables, matching what the UI visually confirms was added.
actual: Save Contact is a silent no-op: no network request fires, no success or error message appears, and the contact is not created (confirmed absent via search afterward). Root cause traced to stale 'required' validators left on the Address/KYC entry-row form controls after '+ Add' clears them - the parent form stays invalid indefinitely and Save exits early with no user-facing feedback. Confirmed the same root cause via direct fix: re-populating the Address fields immediately before Save removed them from Angular's invalid-control list, proving the mechanism. See BUG-006 for full technical root cause and recommended fix for the development team.
